about: Ground truth for the comment check: wrong comments planted into copies of real repositories (each is a realistic kind of comment rot: wrong default, unit, inverted rule, stale name, wrong parameter) and wrong comments found in the original code. Scope 'file': the file itself proves the comment wrong; 'cross': only code in another file does. 'history': comments that maintainers later fixed in a commit that changed only comments (mcp/eval/mine-comment-fixes.mjs); the check runs on the code of the parent commit.

planted.replace: Starts at 0 for the first retry.
